stories.headline: Platform-independent SIMD in Go
stories.summary: The Go Blog Platform-independent SIMD in Go David Chase and Junyang Shao 24 September 2026 Go 1.26 and 1.27 include experimental APIs for Single Instruction Multiple Data (SIMD) operations. stories.headline: ShinyHunters Extorted Boeing Spin-off Prior to Arrests
